title: Unit 2 consolidation: indigenous civilisations
goal: I can talk about the Maya, the Mexica and the Inca and what they left.
grammar: Review: ser passive, preterite and imperfect, cuyo, superlatives, then and now

items: Talk about the Maya, the Mexica and the Inca and what they left.
Say what was built or deciphered, using ser + participle.
Tell what happened and what was going on, using the preterite and the imperfect.
Say whose something was, using cuyo.
Compare the most important things, and contrast then and now.
